fusions.name: Darting Arm
fusions.desc: Whips an arm into the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then darts to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of the original damage.

fusions.name: Slipstream Shove
fusions.desc: Drives a surge of water outward, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and knocking each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Slip the Net
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 30% and your dodge chance by 12% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Wriggle Clear
fusions.desc: When your stamina runs out, you wriggle free and regain 15 stamina. Once every 30 seconds.
